question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the following word.

Reluctant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Reluctant"** means unwilling or disinclined to do something. (अनिच्छुक)
 
 
• **Example: **She was reluctant to accept the job offer because it required moving to another city.
 
 
 
• **"Unwilling"** refers to being not ready or prepared to do something; showing hesitation or lack of enthusiasm. (अनिच्छुक)
 
 
• **Example: **He was unwilling to participate in the event due to his prior commitments.
